description: This file is a shell script used for automating testing of a git-svn integration, including repository setup, commit operations, and verification of authorship and commit message integrity.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed, used for structuring the automated tests.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test environment's clock to simulate time passing between commits.
